arxiv-2007-13404.title: YOLOpeds: Efficient Real-Time Single-Shot Pedestrian Detection for Smart Camera Applications
arxiv-2007-13404.creator: Christos Kyrkou
arxiv-2007-13404.description: Abstract Deep Learning-based object detectors can enhance the capabilities of smart camera systems in a wide spectrum of machine vision applications including video surveillance, autonomous driving, robots and drones, smart factory, and health monitoring. Pedestrian detection plays a key role in all these applications and deep learning can be used to construct accurate state-of-the-art detectors.

arxiv-2206-14976.title: Semi-Supervised Generative Adversarial Network for Stress Detection Using Partially Labeled Physiological Data
arxiv-2206-14976.creator: Nibraas Khan, Nilanjan Sarkar
arxiv-2206-14976.description: Abstract Physiological measurements involves observing variables that attribute to the normative functioning of human systems and subsystems directly or indirectly. The measurements can be used to detect affective states of a person with aims such as improving human-computer interactions. There are several methods of collecting physiological data, but wearable sensors are a common, non-invasive tool for accurate readings.

arxiv-2305-18321.title: Training an Ising Machine with Equilibrium Propagation
arxiv-2305-18321.creator: Jérémie Laydevant, Danijela Marković, Julie Grollier
arxiv-2305-18321.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jérémie Laydevant, Danijela Marković, Julie Grollier. Ising machines, which are hardware implementations of the Ising model of coupled spins, have been influential in the development of unsupervised learning algorithms at the origins of Artificial Intelligence (AI). However, their application to AI has been limited due to the complexities in matching supervised training methods with Ising machine physics, even though these methods are essential for achieving high accuracy.

arxiv-2405-17518.title: Assessment of Left Atrium Motion Deformation Through Full Cardiac Cycle
arxiv-2405-17518.creator: Abdul Qayyum, Moona Mazher, Angela Lee, Jose A Solis-Lemus, Imran Razzak, Steven A Niederer
arxiv-2405-17518.description: Abstract Unlike Right Atrium (RA), Left Atrium (LA) presents distinctive challenges, including much thinner myocardial walls, complex and irregular morphology, as well as diversity in individual’s structure, making off-the-shelf methods designed for the Left Ventricle (LV) may not work in the context of the left atrium.

arxiv-2406-00254.title: defect invariant nakayama algebras
arxiv-2406-00254.creator: Emre SEN, Gordana Todorov, Shijie Zhu
arxiv-2406-00254.description: Abstract . We show that for a given Nakayama algebra Θ \Theta , there exist countably many cyclic Nakayama algebras Λ i \Lambda_{i} , where i ∈ ℕ i\in\mathbb{N} , such that the syzygy filtered algebra of Λ i \Lambda_{i} is isomorphic to Θ \Theta and we describe those algebras Λ i \Lambda_{i} .

arxiv-2410-07045.title: Universal transversal gates
arxiv-2410-07045.creator: Pragati Gupta, Andrea Morello, Barry C. Sanders
arxiv-2410-07045.description: Abstract A long-standing challenge in quantum error correction is the infeasibility of universal transversal gates, as shown by the Eastin-Knill theorem. We obtain a necessary and sufficient condition for a quantum code to have universal transversal gates and show that the Eastin-Knill no-go result is a special case that does not hold for a general error model.

arxiv-2502-03751.title: Symmetry-breaking induced surface magnetization in non-magnetic RuO 2
arxiv-2502-03751.creator: Dai Q. Ho, D. Quang To, Ruiqi Hu, Garnett W. Bryant, Anderson Janotti
arxiv-2502-03751.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dai Q. Ho, D. Quang To, Ruiqi Hu, Garnett W. Bryant, Anderson Janotti. Altermagnetism is a newly identified phase of magnetism distinct from ferromagnetism and antiferromagnetism. RuO 2 has been considered a prototypical metallic altermagnet with a critical temperature higher than room temperature.

arxiv-2503-07879.title: Datasets, Documents, and Repetitions: The Practicalities of Unequal Data Quality
arxiv-2503-07879.creator: Alex Fang, Hadi Pouransari, Matt Jordan, Alexander Toshev, Vaishaal Shankar, Ludwig Schmidt, Tom Gunter
arxiv-2503-07879.description: Abstract Data filtering has become a powerful tool for improving model performance while reducing computational cost. However, as large language model compute budgets continue to grow, the limited data volume provided by heavily filtered and deduplicated datasets will become a practical constraint.

arxiv-2505-11962.title: CrafText Benchmark: Advancing Instruction Following in Complex Multimodal Open-Ended World
arxiv-2505-11962.creator: Zoya Volovikova, Gregory Gorbov, Petr Kuderov, Aleksandr I. Panov, Alexey Skrynnik
arxiv-2505-11962.description: Abstract Following instructions in real-world conditions requires a capability to adapt to the world’s volatility and entanglement: the environment is dynamic and unpredictable, instructions can be linguistically complex with diverse vocabulary, and the number of possible goals an agent may encounter is vast.

arxiv-2512-01008.title: LISA-3D: Lifting Language-Image Segmentation to 3D via Multi-View Consistency
arxiv-2512-01008.creator: Zhongbin Guo, Jiahe Liu, Wenyu Gao, Yushan Li, Chengzhi Li, Ping Jian
arxiv-2512-01008.description: Abstract Text-driven 3D reconstruction demands a mask generator that simultaneously understands open-vocabulary instructions and remains consistent across viewpoints. We present LISA-3D , a two-stage framework that lifts language-image segmentation into 3D by retrofitting the instruction-following model LISA with geometry-aware Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) layers and reusing a frozen SAM-3D reconstructor.

europmc-pmc3730086.creator: Koob GF.
europmc-pmc3730086.description: Drug addiction can be defined by a three-stage cycle - binge/intoxication, withdrawal/negative affect, and preoccupation/anticipation - that involves allostatic changes in the brain reward and stress systems. Two primary sources of reinforcement, positive and negative...

pmc-10689796.title: Low-field NMR with multilayer Halbach magnet and NMR selective excitation
pmc-10689796.creator: Ahmad Telfah, Ahmed Bahti, Katharina Kaufmann, Enno Ebel, Roland Hergenröder, Dieter Suter
pmc-10689796.description: This study introduces a low-field NMR spectrometer (LF-NMR) featuring a multilayer Halbach magnet supported by a combined mechanical and electrical shimming system. This setup offers improved field homogeneity and sensitivity compared to spectrometers relying on typical Halbach and dipole magnets.

pmc-11306485.title: Outcome of whole brain irradiation with a dose-escalated simultaneous-integrated boost in patients with multiple large and/or diffuse brain metastases: real live data and review of the literature
pmc-11306485.creator: Linda Agolli, Luca Nicosia, Thomas Hilger, Gheorghe Iancu, Ann-Katrin Exeli, Bastian Eul, Tobias Struffert, Till Acker, Daniel Habermehl
pmc-11306485.description: BackgroundWe retrospectively investigate feasibility and safety of whole brain radiotherapy (WBRT) including a simultaneous-integrated boost technique (WBRT-SIB) in a cohort of patients with a very poor prognosis suffering from multiple and/or large brain metastases, unfavorable primary histology, poor performance status and/or symptomatic BMs.

pmc-11492056.title: From ST-Segment Elevation MI to Occlusion MI
pmc-11492056.creator: Jesse McLaren, José Nunes de Alencar, Emre K Aslanger, H Pendell Meyers, Stephen W Smith
pmc-11492056.description: A generation ago thrombolytic therapy led to a paradigm shift in myocardial infarction (MI), from Q-wave/non-Q-wave to ST-segment elevation MI (STEMI) vs non-STEMI. Using STE on the electrocardiogram (ECG) as a surrogate marker for acute coronary occlusion (ACO) allowed for rapid diagnosis and treatment.

pmc-11511339.title: Asymmetric-Based Residual Shrinkage Encoder Bearing Health Index Construction and Remaining Life Prediction
pmc-11511339.creator: Baobao Zhang, Jianjie Zhang, Peibo Yu, Jianhui Cao, Yihang Peng, Pavlos Lazaridis
pmc-11511339.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) of bearings is crucial for maintaining the reliability and availability of mechanical systems. Constructing health indicators (HIs) is a fundamental step in the methodology for predicting the RUL of rolling bearings. Traditional HI construction often involves determining the degradation stage of the bearing by extracting time–frequency domain features from raw data using a priori knowledge and setting artificial thresholds; this approach does not fully utilize the vibration information in the bearing data.

pmc-12489554.title: The polyp puzzle: multiple lesions, one diagnosis
pmc-12489554.creator: Eunae Cho
pmc-12489554.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Colonoscopic examination revealed more than 100 colorectal polyps throughout the entire colon. Her medical history included hypothyroidism, for which she had been taking levothyroxine 100 µg daily for five years, and a past diagnosis of epilepsy.

pmc-12542053.title: The effects of salvia hispanica (chia seeds) on insulin sensitivity, hematological inflammatory indices and liver function in obese patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD)
pmc-12542053.creator: Sara Arefhosseini, Maryam Parimi, Helda Tutunchi, Mehrangiz Ebrahimi-Mameghani
pmc-12542053.description: ObjectiveTo examine the effects of chia seeds on insulin sensitivity, hematological inflammatory indices (HIIs), liver function, and steatosis in obese patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).MethodsThis single-blinded randomized controlled clinical trial was carried out on 44 newly diagnosed obese patients with NAFLD.

pmc-12913222.title: Efficacy and Safety of Dextrose Prolotherapy Versus Corticosteroid Injections in Plantar Fasciitis: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-12913222.creator: Ruaa Mustafa Qafesha, Hammam Anas Ishreiteh, Adli Luay Nassourah, Omar Islam Tawil, Doaa Mashaly
pmc-12913222.description: BackgroundPlantar fasciitis (PF) is a common cause of heel pain that affects the health‐related quality of life of many individuals and has various treatment options. Two effective interventions are corticosteroid (CS) injections and dextrose prolotherapy (DP). This study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of DP and CS in patients with PF systematically.

pmc-13271918.title: FLOW800−guided microsurgical resection of a brainstem hemangioblastoma with AVM−like features: a case report and technical note
pmc-13271918.creator: Ying Yang, Chunfeng Pan, Chuan He, Zhaobin Chen, Zhaoyi Quan, Gang Cao
pmc-13271918.description: BackgroundBrainstem hemangioblastomas (HBs) are rare, highly vascularized benign tumors that pose significant surgical challenges due to their deep location, proximity to critical neural structures, and arteriovenous malformation (AVM)-like angioarchitecture. Preoperative embolization carries a high risk of edema or hemorrhage, and piecemeal resection is often impossible.

pmc-13380474.title: Fertility-preserving management of heterotopic cesarean scar pregnancy after laparoscopic repair for cesarean scar disorder: a case report
pmc-13380474.creator: Kenichiro Hirotani, Teruhiko Kawamura, Takeshi Kuramoto, Kiyoko Kato
pmc-13380474.description: Heterotopic pregnancy involving cesarean scar implantation is rare and difficult to manage when continuation of a viable intrauterine pregnancy is desired. Evidence is particularly limited for cases occurring after surgical repair for cesarean scar disorder.A 40-year-old woman with three previous cesarean deliveries underwent laparoscopic repair for symptomatic cesarean scar disorder before assisted reproductive technology.

pmc-13506917.title: Transdiagnostic clinical correlates for behaviors of concern in pediatric neurodevelopmental disorders: a retrospective chart review and machine learning analysis
pmc-13506917.creator: Myka Estes, Margaret Ryan, Sara Early, Kimberly Amador, Noah Bloom, Amani Ahmed, Anza Momin, Tina R. Ram, Nils D. Forkert, Sarah J. MacEachern
pmc-13506917.description: IntroductionBehaviors of concern, such as aggression and self-injury, are common in children with neurodevelopmental disorders and contribute substantially to caregiver stress and health system burden. However, most evidence on behaviors is drawn from diagnostically homogeneous samples, limiting relevance to real-world presentations encountered in tertiary care.

uslaw-usc-t15-s6310.title: 15 U.S.C. § 6310 — Notification of supervising boxing commission
uslaw-usc-t15-s6310.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t15-s6310.description: United States Code, Title 15 (Commerce And Trade); Chapter 89 (Professional Boxing Safety). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Each promoter who intends to hold a professional boxing match in a State that does not have a boxing commission shall, not later than 14 days before the intended date of that match, provide written notification to the supervising boxing commission designated under section.
